posts.text:
It's impossible to buy a new car that isn't a "smart car" and that really sucks.

People tease me for being an analog evangelist but I cannot recommend it enough. I drive a '74 Super Beetle &  people call it a death trap but ALL vehicles are, especially when there's so much tech to distract you.

We need better transit and bike infrastructure more than ever.

posts.text:
It’s hard not to think of everything we were promised in the 2010s: ubiquitous self-driving robotaxis, hyperloop systems, boring company tunnels to sold traffic, and even flying cars.

What did it all amount to? More tracking and maybe even more ads.

posts.text:
In the 2010s, we were told new tech would revolutionize transportation.

As BMW faces backlash for sticking a Spider-Man ad on its center console, we can see what it really amounted to: cars that collect vast quantities of data on us and which automakers are desperate to use to push ads on us too.
